title: searchfor Grammar index
description: grammars/index.json: the Grammar Helpers that `s4 --install-grammar` can install (spec §7). Readers ignore fields they do not know, so later versions may add fields.

version.description: Version of this format; s4 reads version 1.

name.description: The Grammar's name, as in `--install-grammar <name>` and the Definition's `grammar`. It becomes a directory and a file name (M2 plan, D30).

version.description: Version of the Grammar the helper carries.

source.description: Where the Grammar comes from: its crate or repository.

definition.description: The Format Definition installed with the helper, as TOML text: `processor = "treesitter"` and `grammar` equal to `name`.

binaries.description: The helper binary per system, `<os>-<arch>` as Rust's std::env::consts names them (`linux-x86_64`, `macos-aarch64`, `windows-x86_64`; M2 plan, D14).

url.description: Where to download the binary; only https:// and file:// are accepted.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the binary, lower-case hex.
